prompts: Read the CHANGELOG.md in this repo and tell me what changed since the last tag, grouped into features, fixes and breaking changes.

Turn the final notes into a short email to customers and a 3-line post for our changelog page.
What shipped since v2.3.0? I need to write it up for customers.

Write the release notes and email them to our customers.
